# ROYAL-CAPITAL-KERNEL — 유한 로드맵

```text
CURRENT_DESIGN_STAGE   RCK-DESIGN-R0 COMPLETE
NEXT                   ROYAL-CAPITAL-KERNEL-R0A-CP0
TERMINAL               ROYAL-CAPITAL-KERNEL-R0F
AUTO_CONTINUATION      FORBIDDEN
```

각 stage는 source preservation, functional qualification, stage completion을 분리해 판정한다.

---

# R0A — SOURCE/REFERENCE FENCE, MACHINE CONTRACTS & CHILD-DESIGN FREEZE

## CP0 — exact baseline and concept fence

- concept PNG hash·role 고정
- 실제 사용할 최신 WORLD-CONTINENT, WORLD-FIELD, PAP, P0BB accepted baseline 고정
- project source/read path와 license/provenance 고정

완료 gate:

```text
R0A_CP0_CONCEPT_REF=PASS
R0A_CP0_PROJECT_BASELINES_EXACT=PASS
R0A_CP0_SOURCE_LICENSE_PROVENANCE=PASS
```

## CP1 — SITE / URBAN / NETWORK child designs

- site fitting, hydrology, palace hill
- civic/social hierarchy, districts
- roads, blocks, parcels, service corridors

## CP2 — FORTIFICATION / BUILDING / ARCHITECTURE child designs

- walls, gates, towers, bridges
- generic building topology and massing
- roof/facade/style/age grammar

## CP3 — LANDMARK / UTILITY / INTERIOR child designs

- palace, temple, council, knights, guild
- water/heating/mana/ward/drainage
- activities, furniture, interior placement

## CP4 — ART / RUNTIME child designs and machine freeze

- material/lookdev/view profiles
- cook/LOD/HLOD/streaming/collision/nav/save
- schema·CSV·example closure

R0A completion:

```text
R0A_ALL_CHILD_DESIGNS_ACCEPTED=PASS
R0A_MACHINE_SCHEMA_EXAMPLES=PASS
R0A_OSS_ADOPTION_STATES_EXPLICIT=PASS
R0A_IMPLEMENTATION_STARTED=false until promotion
```

---

# R0B — SITE, SOCIAL HIERARCHY, DEFENSIVE RINGS & MACRO URBAN PROGRAM

## CP1 — capital site plan

- terrain suitability
- river crossing and flood/service constraints
- palace hill and foundation zones

## CP2 — district hierarchy program

- required district roles
- density/service/access profile
- visual hierarchy and historical layers

## CP3 — ceremonial axis and defensive rings

- main gate → royal way → palace axis
- outer/inner wall corridors and gate reservations
- major civic and military nodes

## CP4 — deterministic macro compile and genericity proof

- same request/seed byte-identical
- shuffled input stable
- second city fixture through same core path

R0B output is plans and reservations. Detailed architecture geometry is non-goal.

---

# R0C — ROAD/BLOCK/PARCEL GRAPH, RESERVATIONS & EXACT PRODUCER BINDING

## CP1 — road and service network

- road hierarchy, intersections, grades, bridges
- public/service corridors

## CP2 — blocks and parcels

- block polygons
- parcel subdivision
- frontage/depth/courtyard constraints
- public-space keepouts

## CP3 — landmark/fortification/building reservations

- exact sites and sockets
- overlap/access/visibility/defense evidence

## CP4 — generic requirement resolution and Producer binding

- exact Definition/Producer candidates
- bounded selection
- stale snapshot rejection
- no producer-name switch

R0C completion requires plans to reopen through ArtifactStore and baseline+patch=full.

---

# R0D — DOMAIN PRODUCER FAN-OUT & INTEGRATED GRAYBOX CAPITAL

## CP1 — site, roads, fortifications

- terrain integration
- road/bridge graybox
- outer/inner walls, towers, gates

## CP2 — generic buildings and roofs/facades

- parcel-to-building materialization
- multi-floor/room/opening/core
- roof and facade recipes

## CP3 — hero landmarks and utilities

- palace/temple/council/knights/guild complexes
- water/heating/mana/drainage networks

## CP4 — interiors and integrated graybox traversal

- selected playable interiors
- furniture/activity plans
- integrated city assembly
- camera/readability plates

R0D does not claim final materials, performance or product release.

---

# R0E — GODOT PRODUCTIZATION, STREAMING, NAVIGATION & VISUAL LOCK

## CP1 — art target and material realization

- restrained medieval/renaissance palette
- weathering and age layers
- magic infrastructure visibility budget
- fixed camera/view envelopes

## CP2 — cooked assets and streaming

- P0BB product codec/full-proxy wiring
- explicit LOD/HLOD recipes
- sector/interest/prefetch integration

## CP3 — collision, navigation and traversal

- static/dynamic collision
- agent profiles and nav regions
- gate/bridge/street/interior traversal

## CP4 — save/reopen and target performance

- stored-copy import/reopen
- deterministic product replay
- bounded frame/memory/streaming budgets

R0E product acceptance is separate from final human art approval.

---

# R0F — REFERENCE CAPITAL CLOSURE & ROADMAP TERMINATION

## CP1 — final integrated capital

- complete target district hierarchy
- hero/playable/support/distant coverage
- no required placeholder geometry

## CP2 — multi-view and gameplay LQA

- macro aerial view
- main gate and royal way
- palace approach
- noble, guild, common and riverside districts
- wall/bridge/industrial service views
- playable traversal captures

## CP3 — reproducibility and package closure

- clean deterministic rebuild
- exact Definition/Instance/Producer refs
- ArtifactStore reopen
- final full and initial-baseline cumulative patch equivalence
- source/license/provenance closure

## CP4 — terminal decision

```text
ROYAL_CAPITAL_REFERENCE_PRODUCT=ACCEPTED or explicit HOLD
RCK_ROADMAP_STATUS=COMPLETE
TERMINAL_STAGE=R0F
NEXT_STAGE=NONE
AUTO_CONTINUATION=FORBIDDEN
```

새 왕도 variant, 후작성, 백작성은 R0G가 아니라 Definition/Profile/Producer revision 또는 별도 product roadmap으로 추가한다.

```text
RCF_R0A_CP0_SOURCE=PASS
RCF_R0A_CP0_RUNTIME=ADMITTED
RCF_R0A_CP0_GLOBAL_INSTALL=false
```

- neutral request/result models
- units/frame/tolerance contract
- typed status normalization
- CADProviderReceipt and stored-copy export
- no build123d public type leakage

### CP2 — straight wall-span pilot

- one straight foundation/body/walk/parapet profile
- semantic parts and sockets
- fixed tessellation
- same clean run byte-identical

### CP3 — source coverage and negative gates

- BREP/part → semantic surface → triangle ranges
- invalid input/budget/stale/runtime mismatch gates
- no partial output

### CP4 — R0A closeout

- exact runtime replay
- final full/patch/source equality
- R0A terminal report; R0B starts only by explicit approval

---

---

## R0E — ring assembly and product derivation

### CP1
outer/inner ring assembly, exact module refs, foundation/road/bridge binding

### CP2

### CP3

### CP4

---

## R0F — reference fortification closeout

### CP2

---

## R0A — CAD runtime, adapter, primitive contract

### CP0 — exact source/runtime admission

- build123d exact source and selected reference freeze
- Python/OCP complete offline wheel closure
- fresh materialization, `pip check`, import/capability probe
- CadQuery/Building Tools reference bytes/license 확인

Gate:

```text
RCF_R0A_CP0_SOURCE=PASS
RCF_R0A_CP0_RUNTIME=ADMITTED
RCF_R0A_CP0_GLOBAL_INSTALL=false
```

### CP1 — project-owned provider adapter

- neutral request/result models
- units/frame/tolerance contract
- typed status normalization
- CADProviderReceipt and stored-copy export
- no build123d public type leakage

### CP2 — straight wall-span pilot

- one straight foundation/body/walk/parapet profile
- semantic parts and sockets
- fixed tessellation
- same clean run byte-identical

### CP3 — source coverage and negative gates

- BREP/part → semantic surface → triangle ranges
- invalid input/budget/stale/runtime mismatch gates
- no partial output

### CP4 — R0A closeout

- exact runtime replay
- final full/patch/source equality
- R0A terminal report; R0B starts only by explicit approval

---

## R0B — path spans, joins and terrain interface

### CP1
straight/curved span with canonical centerline and local frame

### CP2
miter/bevel/profile-transition joins

### CP3
terrain-stepped and retaining spans; foundation interface evidence

### CP4
mixed-span fixture, segmentation determinism and R0B closeout

---

## R0C — towers and repeated defensive modules

### CP1
round/square/polygonal tower families

### CP2
corner/tangent/wall-penetrating tower joins

### CP3
battlement rhythm, merlon/crenel/module instancing

### CP4
tower + wall-walk sockets, second profile fixture, R0C closeout

---

## R0D — gate complexes

### CP1
minor gate and portal clearance

### CP2
main gatehouse and flanking towers

### CP3
barbican, water gate, postern, bridge/portcullis/drawbridge sockets

### CP4
optional Manifold complex CSG qualification or explicit unsupported; R0D closeout

---

## R0E — ring assembly and product derivation

### CP1
outer/inner ring assembly, exact module refs, foundation/road/bridge binding

### CP2
WORLD-FIELD gatehouse/tower interior requirement and wall-walk traversal binding

### CP3
P0BB cook, LOD/HLOD/source coverage and collision/nav inputs

### CP4
Godot stored-copy import/reopen and integrated graybox plate

---

## R0F — reference fortification closeout

### CP1
Caelmere outer-ring reference assembly

### CP2
second fixture: smaller non-royal fortified town, same core path

### CP3
clean rebuild, edit/rebuild locality, package/provenance closure

### CP4 — terminal

```text
RC_FORTIFICATION_REFERENCE=ACCEPTED or explicit HOLD
RC_FORT_ROADMAP=COMPLETE
NEXT=NONE
AUTO_CONTINUATION=FORBIDDEN
```
